title: Sebastian and the Songbook
author: Tamsin Whitlock
blurb: Ansel Galloway, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
